name: tpl-absence-2-nogoal
task: Don't drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task is a prohibition on dropping the key while the door is closed, which maps to Absence(key_lost). key_lost is exactly the event of dropping the carried key while door_open is false, and it is hard because 'don't' carries no preference cue. The task commands nothing, so the rule-only warning and the empty FINAL_STATES are valid.

texts: Never drop the key while the door is still closed (the key_lost event must never occur)
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
REJECTING_STATES: u1
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, key_lost) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, key_lost, u1) -> -10
